data.body:
Fix implemented + validated in worktree wt-96d1 (branch fix/96d1-completion-sig):

- Grandfather on READ in compute_validity (attest.py): a signed material hash that byte-exactly matches the LEGACY (non-checkbox-normalized) recomputation of CURRENT material is not stale — proves zero edits. Applies to both completion-verifier and plan-review branches. No event mutation.
- pass1.material_fingerprint gained normalize_checkboxes kwarg (default True); impl moved to relation_snapshot.current_material_fingerprint_impl (module-size cap).
- Observability: transition_close now warns on stderr when closing WITHOUT a signature due to certifiable=False; PASS sidecar now records certifiable.

Evidence:
- RED first: 4 targeted failures on origin/main (2x stale-material on unchanged material, missing sidecar certifiable, missing stderr warning); negative controls (real text edit still stale) passed.
- GREEN: tests/unit/test_legacy_material_grandfather_96d1.py (5) + test_compute_validity (13) pass; 1212 related unit tests pass; 415 lifecycle interface tests pass; lint + mypy clean.
- Mutation check: forcing _legacy_material_ok -> False sends both grandfather tests RED; restore -> GREEN.
- Real-store replication: with the fix, epic 2f4c's four previously-invalid children (433c, 9d07, a584, d3ed) now read certified/valid=True via compute_validity — the epic close would have been certifiable.
